hazard.primary: ART Bay Shoreline Flood Explorer (BCDC) inundation extents
hazard.fallback: connected bathtub on USGS 3DEP 1 m LiDAR (used only where no ART level is configured)
hazard.note_5ft: ART has no 60 in layer; the 5 ft scenario uses ART 66 in (5.5 ft), conservative
hazard.depth_note: Depth estimated as water level minus LiDAR ground inside ART's extent
